adi-01-naimisha.line: In Naimisha forest, the sages gather and ask for the tale of the Bharatas.
Tell us, Sauti — how did one house inherit a curse that would demand a war?
Then listen. It begins with a king, a river, and a vow.

adi-02-snake-sacrifice.line: For my father's death, every serpent shall feed these flames!
Stop, King. When does justice become vengeance? Let the rite end.

adi-03-ganga.line: Ganga — seven sons you returned to the river. Spare me the eighth!
Keep him, king. But every gift of the river has its price.

adi-04-bhishma-vow.line: For my father's happiness, I renounce the crown and all children. Let the gods witness.
What have I asked of you, my son? This vow will outlive us all.

adi-05-vyasa-line.line: The throne needs heirs, and the bloodline is knotted. I will do what dharma demands.
Then go, sage. And let history judge what the palace cannot.

adi-06-births.line: A hundred cousins in the nursery — and one basket I set upon the river. Forgive me, Karna.
The mantras I gave you will shape kings, child. Use them wisely.

adi-07-drona.line: Arjuna's arrow finds whatever his eye holds. The rest of you — watch and learn.
Master, my fee will be your honor itself. I will pay it.

adi-08-lakshagriha.line: A palace of lacquer, built to burn us alive. Walk softly, brothers.
I warned you in riddles. The tunnel waits — vanish through the earth.

adi-09-hidimba.line: Hunger walks this forest on two legs, and I am hungrier for justice.
Spare me, strong one — and I will show you love is also a kind of forest.

adi-10-swayamvara.line: The bow has chosen. But a mother's word will bind my garland to five brothers.
I bent it as a Brahmin boy. Let the kings whisper — the fish has fallen.

adi-11-division.line: One kingdom cannot hold both houses. Take the wasteland, Pandavas, and go.
We will take the wasteland, Uncle — and turn exile into a plan.

adi-12-indraprastha.line: Fire cleared Khandava; a white city rises. Every victory contains a wound.
Then let this ending be a seed, Krishna — as every ending is.
